[P1] 长大“干什么”
芭蕾舞演员
［比］丽斯贝特·史蕾洁斯 文/图

[P2] 随着音乐的节奏抬腿，挥动手臂，旋转……
哈，跳舞真是太有趣了！
曼带对着镜子仔细调整着舞姿，她喜欢舞蹈。
她想长大后成为一名芭蕾舞演员。
但是成为一名芭蕾舞演员并不是件容易的事，
需要进行长期的刻苦练习。

[P3] 紧身衣
练习裙
连裤袜
护腿
发髻
发带
芭蕾舞裙
软底芭蕾舞鞋
足尖鞋
演出时，女芭蕾舞演员要穿芭蕾舞裙和足尖鞋。
芭蕾舞裙是由多层半透明薄纱做成的。
足尖鞋是丝质的，鞋头有点硬。
练习时，女芭蕾舞演员会穿半透明的练习裙、软底
芭蕾舞鞋、紧身衣和护腿。
她们会将头发整齐地梳向脑后，挽成一个发髻。

[P4] 芭蕾舞学校
芭蕾舞演员每天都要去芭蕾舞学校。
他们听着悠扬的钢琴曲，在把杆上练习舞蹈动作。
他们还可以在大镜子中看到自己的舞姿是否标准。
演出时，芭蕾舞演员用舞蹈讲故事。
女芭蕾舞演员穿着芭蕾舞裙，把自己打扮得漂漂亮亮。
作为演出的道具，剑和酒杯有时是必不可少的。
此外，舞台的布景也很重要。
有时根据剧情的需要，舞台还可能会被布置成老房子
或者湖边的样子。
镜子
把杆
木地板
钢琴曲
聚光灯
剑
舞台布景道具
化妆品
芭蕾舞包

[P5] 芭蕾舞演员必须睡眠充足，饮食合理，
因为他们每天要进行大量的舞蹈练习。
这也是他们保持身材的秘诀。
看，芭蕾舞演员高高兴兴地进入了芭蕾舞学校。
辛苦一点没关系，因为他们不久就要到大剧院里演出啦！
真是太棒了！

[P6] 芭蕾舞演员跳舞前要先热身，做拉伸练习。
接着，他们会在把杆上练习之前学过的舞蹈动作。
他们微笑着，踮起脚尖，优雅地抬起手臂，
他们要让自己的每个动作都优雅漂亮。
伴着优美的钢琴曲，大家不断变换着姿势和舞步。
舞蹈老师站在一边，纠正着他们的舞蹈动作。

[P7] 芭蕾舞演员紧张地排练着，因为他们马上就要演出了。
他们轻跳、跃起，再用脚尖旋转。
这种旋转可是用单脚脚尖完成的哦！厉害吧？
男芭蕾舞演员不时地将他的舞伴高高举起，做出优美的舞蹈动作。

[P8] 演出明天就要开始了。
剧场的舞台布景、灯光都已准备就绪，
演员的芭蕾舞服也都准备好啦！
他们要表演的剧目是《天鹅湖》。
舞台的背景墙被涂成了蓝色，象征着湖水。
虽然时间不多了，但在演出开始之前，芭蕾舞演员还是要不断练习。

[P9] 这一刻终于要来了！
芭蕾舞演员在更衣室里为演出做着最后的准备。
女芭蕾舞演员穿上白色的芭蕾舞裙，戴着有趣的小翅膀发饰，
看起来真像一只只美丽的天鹅。
穿上足尖鞋后，她们开始化妆了。
瞧，红红的嘴唇，长长的睫毛，她们把自己
打扮得多漂亮啊！

[P10] 观众们都在焦急地等待着。
音乐响起，红色的帷幕缓缓拉开。
一阵热烈的掌声后，主角出场了。
哇，好美呀！
这时，其他舞者也陆续登场。

[P11] 表演进行得很顺利。
主角是全场的焦点，她吸引着每个人的目光。
她跳得简直太棒了！
在帷幕旁站着的是编舞和等待出场的舞者。
编舞不仅是整场舞蹈的设计者，还是演员上场的指挥者。

[P12] 表演结束了，所有舞者一起向观众鞠躬。
“太棒了！”全场爆发出雷鸣般的掌声。
有的观众还向舞台上扔鲜花。
芭蕾舞演员开心极了！
他们的表演实在是太精彩了，不是吗？

[P13] 曼蒂想要成为一名芭蕾舞演员。
在芭蕾舞课上，她学会了五个舞蹈动作。
现在跟她一起做，看看你能做到吗？

快看呀，曼蒂已经演示出来啦！
对了，所有的动作，脚尖都要朝外哦！

① 双臂弯曲，双手放在腰前。
脚跟并齐，脚尖朝外。

② 双臂与肩同高，向左右伸展。
双脚分开，与肩同宽，脚尖朝外。

③ 右手臂回到第一个动作，
左手臂保持第二个动作，
右脚跟放在左脚跟前面，
双脚脚尖朝外，并保持身体平衡！

④ 右手臂保持第二个动作，
左手臂优雅地在头部上方自然弯曲。
右脚向前跨一小步，双脚脚尖朝外。

⑤ 两只手臂在头顶弯成一个漂亮的弧形。
右脚放在左脚前面，双脚脚尖朝外。
注意，这个动作非常难哦！
full_text_en:
[P1] Growing Up 'What to Do'
Ballet Dancer
[Belgium] Liesbet Slegers, Text & Illustrations

[P2] Lifting her legs, swinging her arms, spinning... 
Ha, dancing is so much fun! 
Man Dai adjusts her dance pose carefully in front of the mirror. She loves dancing. 
She wants to become a ballet dancer when she grows up. 
But becoming a ballet dancer is not easy, 
it requires long-term hard practice.

[P3] Leotard
Practice Skirt
Tights
Leg Warmers
Bun
Hairband
Ballet Skirt
Soft Ballet Slippers
Pointe Shoes
During performances, female ballet dancers wear ballet skirts and pointe shoes.
The ballet skirt is made of multiple layers of semi-transparent tulle.
Pointe shoes are made of silk, with hard toes.
During practice, female ballet dancers wear semi-transparent practice skirts, soft ballet slippers, leotards, and leg warmers.
They will neatly comb their hair back and tie it into a bun.

[P4] Ballet School
Ballet dancers go to ballet school every day.
They listen to the melodious piano music and practice dance moves at the barre.
They can also see if their posture is standard in the big mirror.
During performances, ballet dancers tell stories through dance.
Female ballet dancers wear ballet tutus to dress themselves up beautifully.
As props for performances, swords and wine glasses are sometimes essential.
Moreover, stage scenery is also very important.
Sometimes, depending on the plot, the stage may be set up to look like an old house
or by the lakeside.
Mirror
Barre
Wooden floor
Piano music
Spotlights
Sword
Stage scenery props
Cosmetics
Ballet bag

[P5] Ballet dancers must get enough sleep and eat healthily,
because they do a lot of dance practice every day.
This is also their secret to maintaining their figure.
Look, the ballet dancers happily enter the ballet school.
It's okay to work hard, because they will soon be performing at the big theater!
This is wonderful!

[P6] Ballet dancers need to warm up and do stretching exercises before dancing.
Then, they practice the dance moves they've learned before at the barre.
They smile, rise onto their toes, and elegantly lift their arms,
they want every movement to be graceful and beautiful.
Accompanied by beautiful piano music, everyone keeps changing their poses and steps.
The dance teacher stands by, correcting their dance movements.

[P7] Ballet dancers are practicing nervously because they are about to perform.
They leap, jump, and spin on their toes.
This kind of spin is done on one foot's toe! Impressive, right?
Male ballet dancers occasionally lift their partners high up, performing graceful dance moves.

[P8] The performance will start tomorrow.
The theater's stage scenery and lighting are all ready,
and the dancers' ballet costumes are prepared too!
The show they will perform is 'Swan Lake'.
The backdrop wall has been painted blue, symbolizing the lake.
Although time is running short, before the performance begins, ballet dancers still need to keep practicing.

[P9] This moment has finally arrived!
Ballet dancers are making their final preparations in the dressing room.
The female ballet dancers put on their white tutus and wear fun little winged hair accessories,
looking just like beautiful swans.
After putting on their pointe shoes, they begin to get ready with makeup.
Look, red lips, long eyelashes—they’re making themselves
look so pretty!

[P10] The audience is anxiously waiting.
Music begins, and the red curtain slowly opens.
After a burst of enthusiastic applause, the main character appears.
Wow, how beautiful!
At this moment, the other dancers also take the stage one by one.

[P11] The performance is going very smoothly.
The lead dancer is the center of attention, capturing everyone's gaze.
She dances absolutely wonderfully!
Standing beside the curtain are the choreographer and dancers waiting to take the stage.
The choreographer is not only the designer of the entire dance, but also the conductor who guides the performers onto the stage.

[P12] The performance ended, and all the dancers bowed together to the audience.
"Bravo!" The entire audience erupted in thunderous applause.
Some audience members even threw flowers onto the stage.
The ballet dancers were overjoyed!
Their performance was truly wonderful, wasn't it?

[P13] Mandy wants to become a ballet dancer.
In ballet class, she learned five dance moves.
Now follow along with her and see if you can do them!

Look, Mandy has already demonstrated them!
Remember, for all moves, point your toes outward!

① Bend your arms and place your hands on your waist.
Keep heels together and toes pointed outward.

② Raise your arms to shoulder height and stretch them left and right.
Stand with feet apart, shoulder-width, toes pointed outward.

③ Bring your right arm back to the first position,
keep your left arm in the second position,
place your right heel in front of your left heel,
point both toes outward, and maintain balance!

④ Keep your right arm in the second position,
gracefully curve your left arm above your head.
Step forward with your right foot, toes pointed outward.

⑤ Curve both arms into a beautiful arc above your head.
Place your right foot in front of your left foot, toes pointed outward.
Note: This move is very difficult!
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页是绘本的封面，标题为《长大“干什么” 芭蕾舞演员》，作者为比利时的丽斯贝特·史蕾洁斯，配有一幅小女孩跳芭蕾舞的插图。
[P2] 本页描绘了小女孩曼带在镜子前模仿芭蕾舞动作，享受舞蹈的乐趣，并表达了她想成为芭蕾舞演员的梦想，同时指出这需要长期刻苦练习。
[P3] 本页介绍了女芭蕾舞演员在演出和练习时所穿的服装及发型，包括芭蕾舞裙、足尖鞋、练习裙、软底芭蕾舞鞋、紧身衣、护腿和发髻，并通过插图展示了这些服饰和发型。
[P4] 本页介绍了芭蕾舞演员的日常练习场景和演出时的舞台元素，包括练习场所、音乐、道具、布景和化妆用品，并通过插图展示了相关物品。
[P5] 本页介绍了芭蕾舞演员需要充足的睡眠和合理饮食以应对高强度训练，并描绘了他们兴高采烈地进入芭蕾舞学校，期待即将到来的剧院演出。
[P6] 本页描绘了芭蕾舞演员在练习时的场景，包括热身、在把杆上练习舞蹈动作、在钢琴伴奏下变换舞步，以及舞蹈老师在一旁纠正动作的过程。
[P7] 本页描绘了芭蕾舞演员在演出前紧张排练的场景，他们进行跳跃、旋转等动作，男舞者还会将女舞伴高高举起，展现了芭蕾舞的优美与技巧。
[P8] 本页描述了芭蕾舞演出前的准备工作，包括舞台布景、灯光和服装的准备，剧目为《天鹅湖》，并强调演员们在演出前仍需持续练习。
[P9] 本页描绘了芭蕾舞演员在演出前于更衣室做最后准备的场景，包括穿上芭蕾舞裙和足尖鞋，并开始化妆打扮。
[P10] 观众在台下焦急等待，音乐响起后红色帷幕拉开，主角登场并受到热烈掌声，随后其他舞者陆续登台。
[P11] 本页描绘了芭蕾舞演出顺利进行的场景，主角舞者表现精彩，吸引全场目光，同时介绍了编舞在幕后指挥和引导演员上场的作用。
[P12] 芭蕾舞演出结束，舞者们向观众鞠躬致谢，观众热烈鼓掌并抛掷鲜花，舞者们感到非常开心。
[P13] 本页介绍了芭蕾舞初学者曼蒂学习的五个基础舞蹈动作，并通过图示和文字分步骤讲解了每个动作的要领，强调脚尖朝外的重要性。
